sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手煞费苦心，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，现已上线，您可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严肃且通常令人心碎的案件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候觉得需要心理支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 如需获取提供保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您应用上的本期节目文稿，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: It was around 6.30pm on Saturday, October 24, 1953, when 15-year-old Evelyn Hartley left her home in the city of La Crosse, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 那是1953年10月24日星期六晚上6点半左右，15岁的伊芙琳·哈特利离开了她在威斯康星州拉克罗斯市的家。

sentences.en: Mature and trustworthy, Evelyn had been tasked with babysitting the 20-month-old daughter of one of her father's colleagues.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳成熟稳重，受托照看她父亲一位同事20个月大的女儿。

sentences.en: Evelyn had only been gone for half an hour when her mother, Ethel, was overcome by an urge to call Evelyn right away.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳离开才半小时，她的母亲埃特尔就突然涌起一股马上给伊芙琳打电话的冲动。

sentences.en: She didn't know why, but she felt a need to check in with her daughter.
sentences.zh: 她不知道为什么，但就是觉得有必要跟女儿联系一下。

sentences.en: Ethel expressed her concerns to her husband, Richard.
sentences.zh: 埃特尔向丈夫理查德表达了她的担忧。

sentences.en: He didn't share her worry.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有跟她一样担心。

sentences.en: Prior to leaving, Evelyn said she would call her parents to touch base at 8.30.
sentences.zh: 出门前，伊芙琳曾说她会在8点半打电话给父母报平安。

sentences.en: Richard had no doubt that their daughter, whom they called Evie, would ring in just over an hour's time as planned.
sentences.zh: 理查德坚信，他们亲切称为埃维的女儿会在一个多小时后按计划打电话来。

sentences.en: But 8.30 came and went without the promised phone call.
sentences.zh: 然而，8点半到了又过去，却迟迟不见承诺的电话。

sentences.en: Richard Hartley dialed the number for the Rasmussen family, whom Evelyn was babysitting for.
sentences.zh: 理查德·哈特利拨通了拉斯穆森一家的电话，伊芙琳正是在那里做保姆。

sentences.en: There was no answer.
sentences.zh: 电话无人接听。

sentences.en: He tried again and again, but the phone continued to ring out.
sentences.zh: 他一次又一次地拨打，但电话始终在盲音中回响。

sentences.en: Wondering whether Evelyn might have gone to one of the Rasmussen's neighbours' homes for some reason,
sentences.zh: 理查德纳闷伊芙琳是不是出于某种原因去了拉斯穆森家某个邻居的家里，

sentences.en: Richard started calling some of them.
sentences.zh: 于是开始给其中一些人打电话。

sentences.en: No one had seen his daughter.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过他的女儿。

sentences.en: By 9.15, Ethel Hartley was convinced something was terribly wrong.
sentences.zh: 到了9点15分，埃特尔·哈特利确信出了大问题。

sentences.en: Richard drove straight to the Rasmussen's home, which was less than two miles away on Heschler Drive.
sentences.zh: 理查德直接驱车前往拉斯穆森的家，该住所距离赫施勒路不到两英里。

sentences.en: From their driveway, Richard could see lights on inside the residence.
sentences.zh: 从车道上，理查德可以看到住宅里面亮着灯。

sentences.en: He could also hear music playing faintly on a radio.
sentences.zh: 他还听到收音机里隐约播放着音乐。

sentences.en: Feeling slightly reassured, Richard knocked on the front door.
sentences.zh: 内心稍稍感到一丝宽慰，理查德敲了敲前门。

sentences.en: Evelyn didn't appear.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳没有出现。

sentences.en: He banged louder and rang the doorbell.
sentences.zh: 他敲得更响了，还按了门铃。

sentences.en: Still, nobody came.
sentences.zh: 然而，依然无人应门。

sentences.en: Grabbing the door handle to let himself in, Richard found it was locked.
sentences.zh: 理查德握住门把手想自己开门进去，却发现门锁着。

sentences.en: He then peered through the front windows into the home's main living area.
sentences.zh: 接着，他透过前窗朝屋里的主要起居区张望。

sentences.en: It looked as though no one was home.
sentences.zh: 看起来里面好像没人。

sentences.en: Richard hurried around to the back of the house where there was a rear door.
sentences.zh: 理查德匆匆绕到房屋背面，那里有一扇后门。

sentences.en: It too was locked.
sentences.zh: 这扇门也是锁着的。

sentences.en: He shouted while pounding on the door, but his efforts were in vain.
sentences.zh: 他一边用力砸门一边大喊，但他的努力都是徒劳。

sentences.en: As Richard paced to the perimeter of the house, he suddenly tripped on something.
sentences.zh: 正当理查德踱步走到房屋边缘时，他突然被什么东西绊倒了。

sentences.en: A mesh screen had been removed from the basement window and was leaning against an exterior wall.
sentences.zh: 地下室窗户上的一扇纱窗被取了下来，斜靠在外墙上。

sentences.en: The window was open and Richard was able to manoeuvre his body inside.
sentences.zh: 窗户开着，理查德得以把身体钻了进去。

sentences.en: As he lulled himself into the dark basement, his feet found a small stepladder below.
sentences.zh: 当他将自己滑入昏暗的地下室时，脚下踩到了一架小梯子。

sentences.en: He straightened up and turned on a light.
sentences.zh: 他站直身子，打开了灯。

sentences.en: Lying at the bottom of the stairs that led into the house above was a small black shoe with tassels.
sentences.zh: 躺在通往上面房屋的楼梯底部的是一只带有流苏的黑色小鞋子。

sentences.en: It belonged to Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 那是伊芙琳的鞋。

sentences.en: The streets of La Crosse were quiet that evening as the annual homecoming football game was underway.
sentences.zh: 当晚拉克罗斯的街道十分安静，因为一年一度的返校美式橄榄球赛正在进行中。

sentences.en: The town's team of La Crosse State Teachers College was taking on their arch-rivals, River Falls.
sentences.zh: 该镇的拉克罗斯州立师范学院队正在对阵他们的死对头里弗福尔斯队。

sentences.en: La Crosse State hadn't lost a game all season and their beloved captain was being recognised in a special ceremony.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯州立队整个赛季未尝败绩，他们深受爱戴的队长正在一场特殊的仪式上接受表彰。

sentences.en: Everyone who had been able to get a ticket was there.
sentences.zh: 所有能买到票的人都去了现场。

sentences.en: La Crosse State Teachers College, now known as the University of Wisconsin-La Crosse, was a big part of the small Riverside City's identity.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯州立师范学院（现更名为威斯康星大学拉克罗斯分校）是这座小型河畔城市身份认同的重要部分。

sentences.en: Although it only had 945 students, the college played a significant role in the community.
sentences.zh: 尽管该学院只有945名学生，但在社区中扮演着举足轻重的角色。

sentences.en: It employed a number of its residents, including physics professor Vigo Rasmussen.
sentences.zh: 它雇用了许多当地居民，其中包括物理学教授维哥·拉斯穆森。

sentences.en: Vigo was looking forward to the homecoming game, which he planned to attend with his wife and 7-year-old daughter.
sentences.zh: 维哥非常期待这场返校节比赛，他计划和妻子以及7岁的女儿一起去观赛。

sentences.en: But his other daughter, 20-month-old Janice, was too young to join them.
sentences.zh: 但他的另一个女儿、20个月大的珍妮丝太小了，无法同行。

sentences.en: About a week before the game, Vigo reached out to the family's regular babysitter to see if she could watch Janice on the night of Saturday October 24.
sentences.zh: 比赛前一周左右，维哥联系了家里的常规保姆，问她能否在10月24日星期六晚上照看珍妮丝。

sentences.en: She couldn't help as she was going to the game also.
sentences.zh: 她帮不上忙，因为她也要去看比赛。

sentences.en: Vigo's regular babysitter was the daughter of a colleague, so Vigo again asked around at work to find a replacement.
sentences.zh: 维哥的常规保姆是一位同事的女儿，于是维哥再次在工作单位四处打听以寻找替代人选。

sentences.en: Biology professor Richard Hartley had a studious and kind 15-year-old daughter named Evelyn who came highly recommended.
sentences.zh: 生物学教授理查德·哈特利有一个爱学习且善良的15岁女儿名叫伊芙琳，她得到了极力推荐。

sentences.en: When Vigo asked if she would be able to watch Janice in a week's time, Evelyn agreed.
sentences.zh: 当维哥询问她是否愿意在一周后照看珍妮丝时，伊芙琳答应了。

sentences.en: Evelyn soon began to have second thoughts.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳很快开始后悔了。

sentences.en: She had a bad feeling about the job.
sentences.zh: 她对这份工作有一种不好的预感。

sentences.en: Plus, she wasn't keen on staying in while everyone else was having fun at the homecoming game.
sentences.zh: 而且，她并不热衷于在别人都在返校节派对上狂欢时独自留守在家。

sentences.en: Evelyn wondered aloud if she could back out of the agreement.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳大声琢磨着自己是否能反悔不干。

sentences.en: Her mother, Ethel, reminded her that she'd made a commitment to the Rasmussons and should do the right thing by sticking to it.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲埃特尔提醒她，她已经对拉斯穆森一家做出了承诺，应该信守承诺，做正确的事。

sentences.en: When Saturday night arrived, Evelyn packed several textbooks so she could study while Janice slept and waited for Vigo Rasmussen to collect her as planned.
sentences.zh: 当星期六晚上到来时，伊芙琳带了好几本教科书，以便在珍妮丝睡觉时学习，并等待维哥·拉斯穆森按计划来接她。

sentences.en: Before leaving, she promised to call her parents at 8.30 to check in, as she always did when she babysat.
sentences.zh: 出门前，她答应父母在8点半打电话回家报平安，就像她平时做保姆时一样。

sentences.en: Vigo Rasmussen picked Evelyn up at 6.30pm and drove her back to his family's house.
sentences.zh: 维哥·拉斯穆森于晚上6点半接走了伊芙琳，并开车把她送回了自己家。

sentences.en: Evelyn set up her textbooks in the living room and Madeline Rasmussen, Vigo's wife, gave her instructions.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳在起居室摆好了教科书，维哥的妻子玛德琳给她交代了注意事项。

sentences.en: It was going to be a straightforward night.
sentences.zh: 这将是一个简单的夜晚。

sentences.en: Janice was to go to bed at 7 o'clock and then all
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝将在7点钟上床睡觉，接下来

sentences.en: Evelyn would have to do was check in on her at 7.15 and cover her with a blanket.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳唯一要做的就是在7点15分去查看一下她的情况并给她盖上毯子。

sentences.en: At 6.45pm, the Rasmussons said goodbye to Evelyn and headed to watch the game.
sentences.zh: 晚上6点45分，拉斯穆森夫妇向伊芙琳道别，动身前去观看比赛。

sentences.en: Two and a half hours later, Richard Hartley stood in the basement of the Rasmussen home.
sentences.zh: 两个半小时后，理查德·哈特利站在拉斯穆森家的地下室里。

sentences.en: He'd let himself in through an open window to find out why his daughter wasn't answering the home's phone or door.
sentences.zh: 他通过一扇开着的窗户钻进屋里，想弄清楚为什么女儿不接家里的电话也不开门。

sentences.en: Having come across one of Evelyn's shoes at the base of the stairs, Richard raced up to the main part of the house.
sentences.zh: 在楼梯底发现伊芙琳的一只鞋子后，理查德冲上了房子的主要区域。

sentences.en: Evelyn's school books were scattered across the living room.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的学习用品散落在起居室各处。

sentences.en: Her brand new eyeglasses were lying on the floor, as was her other black shoe.
sentences.zh: 她崭新的眼镜掉在地板上，她的另一只黑色鞋子也是如此。

sentences.en: Smeared across the light coloured rug was a muddy shoe print.
sentences.zh: 浅色地毯上糊着一个沾满泥土的鞋印。

sentences.en: There were also several drops of blood.
sentences.zh: 还有好几滴血迹。

sentences.en: Richard checked the rest of the house.
sentences.zh: 理查德检查了房子的其余部分。

sentences.en: Janice was unharmed and fast asleep in her crib, but Evelyn was nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝安然无恙，在婴儿床里睡得正香，但伊芙琳却不见踪影。

sentences.en: Local police were preparing to go home after a quiet night when a call came through at 9.49 about a missing teenage girl.
sentences.zh: 当本地警方在度过一个安静的夜晚后正准备下班时，在9点49分接到了一起关于一名失踪女青年的报警电话。

sentences.en: They weren't overly concerned, believing the girl had likely gone to see a boy and would be found within 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 他们并没有过分担忧，认为这个女孩很可能是去找一个男孩了，10分钟内就会被找到。

sentences.en: Two officers arrived at the Rasmussen residence, where Richard Hartley was waiting to meet them.
sentences.zh: 两名警官抵达了拉斯穆森住宅，理查德·哈特利正在那里等着他们。

sentences.en: The officers soon realised how serious the situation was.
sentences.zh: 警官们很快意识到情况有多么严重。

sentences.en: Over a dozen more officers arrived, along with detectives, the district attorney and the La Crosse County Sheriff.
sentences.zh: 十多名更多的警官赶到现场，随之而来的还有侦探、地区检察官以及拉克罗斯县治安官。

sentences.en: The Rasmussons had moved into the house just a few months earlier.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森一家几个月前才搬进这栋房子。

sentences.en: The ordinary, ranch-style suburban home had three bedrooMs.
sentences.zh: 这栋普通的牧场风格郊区住宅有三间卧室。

sentences.en: It was part of a new subdivision and, like many other residences in the neighbourhood, it was so new that its windows had no blinds or curtains.
sentences.zh: 它是新开发区的一部分，和邻近的许多其他住宅一样，它太新了，窗户上还没有百叶窗或窗帘。

sentences.en: It sat close to other houses on the street, and there were enough people around that it didn't feel isolated or remote, even on a quiet night like this.
sentences.zh: 它离街上的其他房子很近，周围有足够多的人，所以即使在一个这样安静的夜晚，也不会让人感到孤立或偏僻。

sentences.en: Outside, investigators noticed someone had used a screwdriver to try and pry open three separate windows.
sentences.zh: 在外面，调查人员注意到有人曾用螺丝刀试图撬开三扇不同的窗户。

sentences.en: A flower bed below one window featured an imprint of a size 11 tennis shoe, matching the muddy shoe print on the living room rug.
sentences.zh: 其中一扇窗户下方的一个花坛里有一个11码网球鞋的印记，与起居室地毯上的泥泞鞋印相吻合。

sentences.en: After failing to jimmy the other windows open, the intruder finally succeeded with the basement window.
sentences.zh: 在撬其他窗户失败后，不速之客最终成功从地下室窗户潜入。

sentences.en: Several red fibres on its surface matched the jeans Evelyn Hartley had been wearing that evening.
sentences.zh: 表面上的几根红色纤维与伊芙琳·哈特利当晚穿的牛仔裤相吻合。

sentences.en: Whoever had broken into the basement had forced the 15-year-old out via the same route.
sentences.zh: 无论谁闯入地下室，都是强行带着这位15岁的女孩从同一条路线离开的。

sentences.en: While it was initially thought the intruder had placed the stepladder under the basement window to
sentences.zh: 虽然最初人们认为闯入者把小梯子放在地下室窗户下是为了

sentences.en: secure their escape, the Rasmussons revealed that they had propped the ladder there on a previous occasion.
sentences.zh: 确保自己能够逃脱，但拉斯穆森夫妇透露，他们之前曾把梯子斜靠在那里。

sentences.en: The fact it sat in such an opportune location for the abductor was merely a coincidence.
sentences.zh: 它恰好处于对绑架者如此有利的位置纯属巧合。

sentences.en: Traces of blood were found inside the basement, with more just outside, about 10 feet from the window.
sentences.zh: 地下室内部发现了血迹，外面距离窗户约10英尺的地方也有更多血迹。

sentences.en: A large pool of blood on the ground nearby was consistent with a severely injured person having laid down there to recover.
sentences.zh: 附近地面上的一大滩血迹与一个受重伤的人曾躺在那里恢复体力的情况相符。

sentences.en: A bloody handprint was smeared across the outside wall of the Rasmussen house.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森家外墙上留下了血手印。

sentences.en: Another was found on the exterior of a neighbour's garage about 100 yards away.
sentences.zh: 在约100码外的一个邻居的车库外表也发现了一个。

sentences.en: Pools of blood lined an external wall of a third house just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 血迹沿着拐角处第三栋房子的外墙排成一滩滩。

sentences.en: The blood was Type A, the same as Evelyn's.
sentences.zh: 血型是A型，与伊芙琳的血型相同。

sentences.en: Bloodhounds tracked the scent for two blocks, but then stopped.
sentences.zh: 寻血猎犬追踪气味走了两个街区，但随后便停下了。

sentences.en: It seemed Evelyn had been forced into a vehicle there and whisked away.
sentences.zh: 看来伊芙琳当时在那里被强行塞进了一辆车并被迅速带走。

sentences.en: An alert was issued and descriptions of Evelyn Hartley were sent out.
sentences.zh: 警方随即发布了警报并散发了伊芙琳·哈特利的体貌特征描述。

sentences.en: 5 foot 7, 126 pounds, straight brown hair and blue eyes.
sentences.zh: 身高5英尺7英寸，体重126磅，直棕发，蓝眼睛。

sentences.en: Last seen wearing red jeans rolled up at the cuff, bobby socks and a white blouse.
sentences.zh: 最后一次露面时身穿裤脚卷起的红色牛仔裤、短袜和一件白衬衫。

sentences.en: Janice Rasmussen was in her crib, but was not covered in a blanket.
sentences.zh: 珍妮丝·拉斯穆森躺在婴儿床里，但身上没有盖着毯子。

sentences.en: This led investigators to assume that Evelyn was confronted within the 15 minute window between
sentences.zh: 这使得调查人员推断，伊芙琳是在7点珍妮丝上床睡觉到7点15分伊芙琳本应给珍妮丝盖毯子这15分钟的时间窗口内遭到袭击的。

sentences.en: Janice's bedtime at 7 and 7.15 when Evelyn was supposed to cover Janice with a blanket.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳的袭击者很可能打出了她的鼻血，这造成了起居室地毯上最初的血迹。

sentences.en: Evelyn's attacker likely gave her a bloody nose, which had caused the initial blood spots on the living room rug.
sentences.zh: 一旦到了地下室外面，袭击者便用窗纱击打伊芙琳，造成了更严重的伤害。

sentences.en: Once outside the basement, the attacker had hit Evelyn with the window screen, causing a greater injury.
sentences.zh: 在绑架者强行将伊芙琳带离拉斯穆森家时，她流失了大量的血。

sentences.en: Evelyn had lost significant amounts of blood as her abductor forced her away from the Rasmussen home.
sentences.zh: 她不时停下来，导致她的血在某些地方汇聚成滩。

sentences.en: She stopped periodically, causing her blood to pool in certain areas.
sentences.zh: 那些血手印是伊芙琳在他们经过的建筑物上拖曳手部时留下的。

sentences.en: The bloody handprints were from Evelyn dragging her hand along the buildings they passed.
sentences.zh: 当理查德·哈特利第二天清晨在刺眼的白日阳光下看到血迹时，他担心女儿在遭遇劫难后未能生还。

sentences.en: When Richard Hartley saw the blood the next morning in the harsh light of day, he feared his daughter hadn't survived her ordeal.
sentences.zh: 血实在太多了。

sentences.en: There was simply too much.
sentences.zh: 这是一个尤为悲惨的想法，因为埃特尔和理查德·哈特利在七年前已经因小儿麻痹症失去过他们的大儿子。

sentences.en: It was a particularly tragic thought, as Ethel and Richard Hartley had already lost their eldest son to polio seven years earlier.
sentences.zh: 埃特尔悲痛欲绝，直到周一才离开家，当时她被带到拉斯穆森家并在犯罪现场由人陪同参观。

sentences.en: Ethel was too distraught to leave her home until Monday, when she was taken to the Rasmussen house and escorted through the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 她在查看起居室和地下室时保持着平静。

sentences.en: She remained calm as she looked at the living room and the basement.
sentences.zh: 但当埃特尔看到外面的血迹时，她彻底崩溃了，靠在丈夫身上寻求支撑。

sentences.en: But when Ethel saw the blood outside, she broke down and lent on her husband for support.
sentences.zh: 哦，我的伊芙琳，她哭喊道。

sentences.en: Oh, my Evelyn, she cried.
sentences.zh: 我们知道她现在已经不在人世了。

sentences.en: We know she isn't alive now.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯的人们前一天晚上完全沉浸在足球比赛中，直到他们周日去教堂聚会时，有关

sentences.en: People in La Crosse had been so absorbed by the football game the night prior that it wasn't until they gathered for Sunday church that news of
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·哈特利被绑架的消息才传开。

sentences.en: Evelyn Hartley's abduction spread.
sentences.zh: 成百上千的当地居民很快涌向

sentences.en: Hundreds of locals soon descended on the
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森的房产提供协助或围观调查人员。

sentences.en: Rasmussen property to offer assistance or gawk at investigators.
sentences.zh: 警方不得不将房子周围的两个街区拉起警戒线，以防现场遭到破坏。

sentences.en: Police had to cordon off two blocks around the house to prevent the scene from becoming contaminated.
sentences.zh: 尽管伊芙琳被带走时天色已黑，但月光明亮，路灯也亮着。

sentences.en: Although night had already fallen by the time Evelyn was taken, the moon was bright and street lamps were lit.
sentences.zh: 和拉斯穆森一家一样，赫施勒沿街的许多居民在他们新修建的房子里还没有安装窗帘或百叶窗。

sentences.en: Like the Rasmussons, many residents along Heschler Drive had yet to install curtains or blinds in their newly built homes.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们可以清晰地看到外面。

sentences.en: Thus, they could see directly outside.
sentences.zh: 街对面，一对夫妇正坐在一间能清楚看到拉斯穆森家视野的房间里听音乐。

sentences.en: Across the street, a couple had sat listening to music in a room with a clear view of the Rasmussons house.
sentences.zh: 另有一个男子当时正在粉刷他家地下室的内部。

sentences.en: Another man had been painting his basement's interior.
sentences.zh: 他的房子正是沾有伊芙琳血迹的其中一栋。

sentences.en: His was one of the homes that was smeared with Evelyn's blood.
sentences.zh: 许多其他邻居当时也在家。

sentences.en: Many other neighbours were home as well.
sentences.zh: 其中一人甚至还在进行深夜园艺活动。

sentences.en: One had even been doing some late night gardening.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，没有人看到伊芙琳或她的袭击者来过或离开。

sentences.en: Despite this, no one had seen Evelyn or her assailant coming or going.
sentences.zh: 不过，埃尔文·索德巴赫在当晚7点左右正坐在他家前廊上，突然传出了两三声尖锐的尖叫声。

sentences.en: However, Elvin Soderbach had been sitting on his front porch at around seven that night when two or three sharp screams suddenly rang out.
sentences.zh: 埃尔文说不清尖叫声来自何方，但在他听来像是小孩子们在玩耍。

sentences.en: Elvin couldn't tell where the screams had originated, but they sounded to him like children playing.
sentences.zh: 最后一声尖叫戛然而止，仿佛被什么东西或什么人打断了。

sentences.en: The final cry cut off abruptly, as though interrupted by something or someone.
sentences.zh: 埃尔文以为是有家长出面干预来管教调皮捣蛋的孩子。

sentences.en: Elvin thought a parent had intervened to discipline the unruly children.
sentences.zh: 埃尔文的妻子当时在厨房里，也听到了尖叫声。她觉得这些叫声听起来并不像她丈夫认为的那样充满玩闹意味。

sentences.en: Elvin's wife, who was in the kitchen, also heard the screaMs. She thought they sounded less playful than her husband did.
sentences.zh: 在她听来，无论谁在尖叫，都仿佛在传达着“住手，离我远点”的信息。

sentences.en: To her, it sounded like whoever was screaming was sending a message of, stop, get away from me.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，埃德·霍法正开车穿过该地区去接他的小舅子，准备前往返校节比赛现场。

sentences.en: That night, Ed Hoffa had been driving through the area to pick up his brother-in-law en route to the homecoming game.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点15分，埃德将车开进与赫施勒路平行的日出大道。

sentences.en: At 7.15pm, Ed pulled in to Sunrise Drive, which ran parallel to Heschler Drive.
sentences.zh: 他汽车的车灯照亮了几个正沿着人行道行走的人。

sentences.en: His car's headlights illuminated several people walking along the footpath.
sentences.zh: 那是两个年轻男子，中间夹着一个年轻女子。

sentences.en: It was two young men with a young woman sandwiched between them.
sentences.zh: 是两个年轻男子，中间夹着一个年轻女子。

sentences.en: The girl was staggering, as though she'd had a few drinks.
sentences.zh: 这个女孩摇摇晃晃的，就像喝了几杯酒一样。

sentences.en: Ed paid them little attention as he pulled over and headed inside his brother-in-law's house.
sentences.zh: 埃德没有过多理会他们，把车停好后，径直走进了他小舅子的房子。

sentences.en: Five minutes later, Ed was driving again with his brother-in-law riding as passenger.
sentences.zh: 五分钟后，埃德重新开车上路，小舅子坐在副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: He headed north on Sunrise.
sentences.zh: 他沿着日出大道向北行驶。

sentences.en: A dark green, two-toned 1942 Buick suddenly careened past in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 一辆深绿色、双色调的1942年产别克汽车突然从反方向疾驰而过。

sentences.en: Its driver was speeding, but Ed still managed to catch a glimpse inside as the car whizzed by.
sentences.zh: 驾驶员工速极快，但当车呼啸而过时，埃德还是设法瞥了一眼车内。

sentences.en: He was certain the car's occupants were the three young people he'd passed on the street minutes earlier.
sentences.zh: 他确信车里的人就是几分钟前他在街上遇到的那三个年轻人。

sentences.en: One of the men was driving, the other sat in the back seat next to the woman.
sentences.zh: 其中一名男子在开车，另一名男子坐在后座上，挨着那个女人。

sentences.en: She was slumped forward, her head pressed against the back of the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 她向前倾身瘫坐着，头部紧紧抵着驾驶座的靠背。

sentences.en: It looked as though she might have been unwell.
sentences.zh: 看起来她可能是身体不太舒服。

sentences.en: Ed had written off the incident at the time as young people having fun.
sentences.zh: 当时埃德把这件事归咎于年轻人贪玩，并未放在心上。

sentences.en: On Monday, he was at work when he heard that a 15-year-old girl had been abducted from a house just around the corner.
sentences.zh: 周一上班时，他听说一个15岁的女孩在拐角处的一栋房子里被绑架了。

sentences.en: Ed then reported his recollections to the police.
sentences.zh: 埃德随即向警方报告了自己回忆起的情况。

sentences.en: He hadn't been able to get a good look at the car's driver.
sentences.zh: 他当时没能看清汽车司机的长相。

sentences.en: He thought the man behind the wheel might have been a local college student, but when police followed up with the student, they found he had an airtight alibi.
sentences.zh: 他认为开车的人可能是当地的一名大学生，但当警方找到这名大学生核实时，发现他有着不在场的铁证。

sentences.en: Pictures of a car matching the Buick's description were given to petrol stations in the area, with employees told to keep an eye out for similar vehicles.
sentences.zh: 印有与那辆别克车特征相符的汽车照片被发给了当地的加油站，并叮嘱员工留意类似车辆。

sentences.en: Police also set up an incentive for people to volunteer their vehicles for searching.
sentences.zh: 警方还设立了奖励，鼓励人们主动让警方搜查自己的汽车。

sentences.en: Members of the public were encouraged to drive to local petrol stations and allow the station's employees to check the back seat and trunk of their cars.
sentences.zh: 公众被鼓励将车开到当地加油站，并允许加油站员工检查汽车的后座和后备箱。

sentences.en: Once they had been given the all clear, they would be given a sticker that read,
sentences.zh: 一旦通过检查确认无误，他们就会得到一张贴纸，上面写着：

sentences.en: My car is okay.
sentences.zh: 我的车没问题。

sentences.en: The sticker would be displayed in the car's window along with the date of the search.
sentences.zh: 贴纸连同搜查日期一起贴在汽车的车窗上。

sentences.en: Any drivers who refused to comply with the search had their details noted by the petrol station employees, who passed them on to police.
sentences.zh: 任何拒绝配合搜查的司机，其信息都会被加油站员工记下来并转交给警方。

sentences.en: 40,000 stickers were printed and the aim was to search every car in the county.
sentences.zh: 印制了4万张贴纸，目的是搜查县里的每一辆车。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《档案》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持《档案》继续创作优质内容。

sentences.en: Ed Hoffer's sighting indicated that
sentences.zh: 埃德·霍费尔看到的景象表明，

sentences.en: Evelyn was taken by two men working together.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳是被两名合伙作案的男子带走的。

sentences.en: The question still remained, was it an opportunistic or planned abduction?
sentences.zh: 问题依然存在，这是一起随机作案还是蓄意绑架？

sentences.en: Nothing had been stolen from the Rasmussen house, but maybe the men had broken in only to be surprised by Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森家里没有任何东西被盗，但也许这伙人破门而入时只是恰好被伊芙琳撞见了。

sentences.en: As she had been covering for the family's regular babysitter, some speculated that perhaps the other girl was the original target.
sentences.zh: 由于她当时是顶替该家庭的御用临时保姆，有人猜测或许另一个女孩才是原本的目标。

sentences.en: The media wondered whether Evelyn Hartley was as squeaky clean as everyone believed.
sentences.zh: 媒体开始怀疑伊芙琳·哈特利是否真如所有人认为的那样清白无瑕。

sentences.en: What if she had a secret life and ran away with a boy?
sentences.zh: 万一她有着不为人知的秘密生活，跟某个男孩私奔了呢？

sentences.en: This notion was entirely dismissed by investigators and everyone who knew her.
sentences.zh: 这种想法很快就被调查人员和所有认识她的人彻底否定了。

sentences.en: It was far more probable that a pair of prowlers had taken advantage of the quiet streets that night to look for potential victiMs. One woman reported that recently
sentences.zh: 更有可能的情况是，两个潜行者利用那天晚上的安静街道寻找潜在的受害者。一名女子报告说，最近

sentences.en: she had been ironing clothes in her basement only to look up to see an unknown man staring through a window at her.
sentences.zh: 她正在地下室熨衣服，一抬头却发现一个陌生男子正透过窗户盯着她。

sentences.en: He laughed and said, I'm going to get you.
sentences.zh: 他笑着说：“我要抓住你。”

sentences.en: Investigators tracked down a man who was known to spy through people's windows.
sentences.zh: 调查人员追踪了一名有偷窥他人窗户前科的男子。

sentences.en: They also interviewed a man who had been convicted of sexually abusing his 12-year-old daughter six years earlier.
sentences.zh: 他们还讯问了一名在六年前因性侵自己12岁女儿而被定罪的男子。

sentences.en: Neither of these lines of enquiry led anywhere,
sentences.zh: 这两条调查路线都没有任何进展，

sentences.en: nor did interviews with 48 other men who were wanted for or associated with various sex crimes.
sentences.zh: 对其他48名被通缉或与各类性犯罪有关的男子的讯问也是如此。

sentences.en: Richard Hartley and Viggo Rasmussen were also looked into, but more so out of procedure than anything else.
sentences.zh: 理查德·哈特利和维戈·拉斯穆森也在调查之列，但更多只是例行公事。

sentences.en: Both men cooperated with authorities and were ruled out of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 两名男子都配合了当局的调查，并被排除了嫌疑。

sentences.en: The cross-residents, businesses and organisations pulled together a reward for information that was the equivalent of almost $71,500 today.
sentences.zh: 当地居民、企业和组织共同凑集了一笔悬赏金，折合今天的金额大约有71,500美元。

sentences.en: Upwards of 2000 people joined the search for Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 多达2000人加入了寻找伊芙琳的搜救队伍。

sentences.en: Bodies of water were dragged, farmers scoured their fields, and hunters were on the lookout while in the woods.
sentences.zh: 人们打捞水体，农民搜寻农田，猎人们在树林里时也保持警惕。

sentences.en: Recently dug graves at cemeteries were checked in case Evelyn's attacker had thought to use one as an easy way to dispose of her.
sentences.zh: 墓地里新掘的坟墓也被检查过，以防伊芙琳的袭击者动了念头，将其用作处理尸体的捷径。

sentences.en: Many of those searching for Evelyn were her peers from her school.
sentences.zh: 许多寻找伊芙琳的人都是她学校同龄的同学。

sentences.en: They were joined by the local Boy Scouts and other community groups.
sentences.zh: 当地童子军和其他社区团体也加入了他们的行列。

sentences.en: Amongst the crowd was Evelyn's 22-year-old brother, Thomas.
sentences.zh: 人群中包括伊芙琳22岁的哥哥托马斯。

sentences.en: He had rushed home from college upon learning of Evelyn's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 得知伊芙琳失踪后，他从大学匆忙赶回了家。

sentences.en: Thomas and a friend covered three miles of La Crosse, removing manholes and then jumping down into the storm sewers to check for Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 托马斯和一位朋友搜寻了拉克罗斯三英里的范围，移开井盖，然后跳进暴雨下水道检查伊芙琳的下落。

sentences.en: When it grew dark, Thomas became upset.
sentences.zh: 天黑时，托马斯情绪崩溃了。

sentences.en: He didn't want to stop looking for his little sister.
sentences.zh: 他不想停止寻找自己的小妹妹。

sentences.en: Wednesday October 28 marked four days since
sentences.zh: 10月28日星期三，标志着

sentences.en: Evelyn Hartley went missing.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·哈特利失踪已经四天了。

sentences.en: Highway 14 two miles south of La Crosse's city limits had been searched the previous day to no result.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯市界以南两英的14号公路在前一天已经搜寻过，但一无所获。

sentences.en: Yet, on Wednesday, a bra and a pair of women's underwear were recovered from the area.
sentences.zh: 然而就在周三，该地区寻获了一件胸罩和一条女式内裤。

sentences.en: The garments were a popular brand and appeared to be Evelyn's size.
sentences.zh: 这些衣物是个受欢迎的品牌，尺码看起来也和伊芙琳相符。

sentences.en: Given they hadn't been spotted previously, it was believed they'd been dumped within the past 24 hours.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此前并未被发现，人们认为它们是在过去24小时内被抛弃的。

sentences.en: They appeared to have been thrown from a moving vehicle that was fleeing south.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来像是从一辆正向南逃窜的行驶中的车辆上被扔出来的。

sentences.en: Both garments were stained with type A blood.
sentences.zh: 这两件衣物上都沾有A型血。

sentences.en: As roughly 40% of the population had this blood type, police couldn't be certain it was Evelyn's.
sentences.zh: 由于大约40%的人口都有这种血型，警方无法确定这一定是伊芙琳的。

sentences.en: Days later, on Friday October 31, a third search of Highway 14 was undertaken.
sentences.zh: 几天后的10月31日星期五，警方对14号公路展开了第三次搜寻。

sentences.en: Close to where the bra and underwear had been found, a search party came across two size 11 Goodrich brand sneakers.
sentences.zh: 在发现胸罩和内裤的附近，搜救队偶遇了两只11码的古德里奇（Goodrich）品牌运动鞋。

sentences.en: They too had seemingly been tossed one at a time from a vehicle travelling south.
sentences.zh: 它们似乎也是从一辆向南行驶的汽车上被一只接一只地扔出来的。

sentences.en: The pattern on the soles of the sneakers matched the muddy prints found in the Rasmussen home.
sentences.zh: 运动鞋鞋底的花纹与在拉斯穆森家中发现的泥泞鞋印相吻合。

sentences.en: They had a distinctive circular wear pattern as well, which suggested whoever owned them worked with some kind of machinery.
sentences.zh: 它们还有一个独特的圆形磨损模式，这表明鞋子的主人可能从事某种机械方面的工作。

sentences.en: The shoes also had type A blood on them.
sentences.zh: 鞋子上也沾有A型血。

sentences.en: It was determined that they had been worn by two different people, one whose feet was a size larger than the sneakers.
sentences.zh: 经判定，它们曾被两个人穿过，其中一人的脚比运动鞋还要大一码。

sentences.en: This particular model of sneaker was called the Hood Mogul.
sentences.zh: 这款特定的运动鞋被称为“胡德大亨”（Hood Mogul）。

sentences.en: They'd been available throughout Wisconsin, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, and Illinois, but hadn't been sold in Wisconsin for about three years.
sentences.zh: 它们曾在威斯康星州、爱荷华州、密歇根州、明尼苏达州和伊利诺伊州有售，但在威斯康星州已经大约三年没有销售了。

sentences.en: An unusual marking on the back of the shoes was traced back to a Whizzer motorbike, meaning whoever owned the shoes also rode this make of motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 鞋子背面一个不寻常的标记被追溯到一辆威瑟（Whizzer）摩托车，这意味着鞋子的主人也骑这种品牌的摩托车。

sentences.en: Registration and sales records for Whizzer motorbikes were checked, but the line of inquiry went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 警方核查了威瑟摩托车的注册和销售记录，但这条线索最终断了。

sentences.en: Two and a half weeks later, rumours had reached detectives pertaining to a bloodstained jacket.
sentences.zh: 两周半后，侦探们听到了关于一件沾血夹克的传言。

sentences.en: It had been found about 300 feet from where the sneakers were discovered.
sentences.zh: 它是在距离发现运动鞋约300英尺的地方被找到的。

sentences.en: Farmers had noticed the jacket lying on the highway's shoulder as they drove past each day.
sentences.zh: 农民们每天开车经过时，都注意到这件夹克躺在公路的路肩上。

sentences.en: One had picked it up and thrown it in the back of his truck, then promptly forgot about it.
sentences.zh: 其中一人把它捡起来扔进卡车后斗，随后就把它忘得一干二净。

sentences.en: The police identified the farmer and took possession of the jacket.
sentences.zh: 警方确认了这名农民的身份并拿到了这件夹克。

sentences.en: It was denim and looked like the kind of jacket worn by people who worked outdoors.
sentences.zh: 它是牛仔布材质的，看起来像是户外工作者穿的那种夹克。

sentences.en: It had been cut along the bottom, then re-hemmed with a sewing machine using white thread.
sentences.zh: 它的底部被剪短过，然后用缝纫机和白线重新缝了边。

sentences.en: This had resulted in strange shallow pockets, and like the shoes, it had spots of type A blood on it, on the front, back and the sleeves.
sentences.zh: 这导致口袋变得奇怪而浅，而且和鞋子一样，它的正面、背面和袖子上都有A型血的血迹斑点。

sentences.en: Smears of blood in the Rasmussen home looked to be the result of a denim-type fabric being rubbed against surfaces.
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森家中的血迹涂抹痕迹看起来像是牛仔面料与物体表面摩擦导致的。

sentences.en: It seemed unlikely that the person who owned the shoes had also owned the jacket.
sentences.zh: 拥有这双鞋的人不太可能也拥有这件夹克。

sentences.en: The size 11 shoes indicated a taller owner, whereas a size 36 jacket would belong to a smaller man.
sentences.zh: 11码的鞋表明主人个子较高，而36码的夹克则属于体型较小的男子。

sentences.en: Once again, clues in the case seemed to point to two perpetrators.
sentences.zh: 案件中的线索再次似乎指向了两个作案者。

sentences.en: The jacket had faded spots under the armpits, possibly caused by a safety harness commonly worn by people who worked as steeplejacks.
sentences.zh: 这件夹克的腋下部位有褪色斑点，可能是由高空作业人员常用的安全背带引起的。

sentences.en: They climbed tall structures like chimneys and steeples to carry out repairs.
sentences.zh: 他们攀爬烟囱和尖顶等高大建筑物来进行维修。

sentences.en: Detectives learned that a local man had manufactured safety harnesses for two steeplejacks the previous year.
sentences.zh: 侦探们得知，前一年曾有一名当地人给两个高空作业人员制作过安全背带。

sentences.en: But all he remembered about them was that they were young and possibly from the area.
sentences.zh: 但他对这两个人仅有的记忆是他们很年轻，可能来自当地。

sentences.en: Police had the bloodied jacket and shoes toured through 31 different towns within a 40-mile radius of La Crosse.
sentences.zh: 警方带着这件带血的夹克和鞋子，在以拉克罗斯为中心、40英里半径内的31个不同城镇进行巡回展示。

sentences.en: They were displayed at local fairs and in public places, in hopes someone would recognise them.
sentences.zh: 它们在当地集市和公共场所展出，希望有人能认出它们。

sentences.en: As all their leads dried up, investigators sought to polygraph test every male student and school faculty member within the area.
sentences.zh: 由于所有的线索都断了，调查人员试图对该地区的所有男学生和学校教职员工进行测谎测试。

sentences.en: This would amount to a total of around 1,750 tests, making it the largest mass polygraph examination in United States history.
sentences.zh: 这将总计约1,750次测试，使其成为美国历史上规模最大的集体测谎检查。

sentences.en: Students cooperated without complaint.
sentences.zh: 学生们毫无怨言地予以配合。

sentences.en: They were asked questions such as, are you withholding any information regarding the Evelyn Hartley disappearance case?
sentences.zh: 他们被问到诸如“你是否隐瞒了有关伊芙琳·哈特利失踪案的任何信息？”之类的问题。

sentences.en: Psychologist Dr.
sentences.zh: 心理学家卡尔·史密斯博士

sentences.en: Carl Smith was critical of the strategy.
sentences.zh: 对这一策略提出了批评。

sentences.en: He told the Associated Press,
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社：

sentences.en: This is a dangerous use of a device that is not even recognised in the courts.
sentences.zh: “这是对一种甚至未在法庭上得到承认的设备的危险使用。”

sentences.en: The tests, even though allegedly on a voluntary basis, are equivalent to a beating.
sentences.zh: “这些测试尽管据称是自愿进行的，但无异于一场殴打。”

sentences.en: There actually is nothing voluntary about submitting to the tests, however, because if a pupil fails to submit, he will be suspected by members of his society.
sentences.zh: “然而，接受测试实际上根本谈不上自愿，因为如果一个学生拒绝接受，他就会遭到同龄人的怀疑。”

sentences.en: No one in the La Crosse community voiced any concerns about the process, but the school board ultimately put a stop to it.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯社区里没有人对这个过程表达担忧，但学校董事会最终叫停了它。

sentences.en: Around 300 boys had already been questioned.
sentences.zh: 大约300名男孩已经接受了盘问。

sentences.en: None of the information gathered proved fruitful.
sentences.zh: 收集到的所有信息都没有取得任何成效。

sentences.en: Every night since Evelyn disappeared, her family left all of the lights on in their house, believing it would help her find her way back to them.
sentences.zh: 自从伊芙琳失踪后的每一个夜晚，她的家人都把屋里的灯全部亮着，相信这能帮她找到回家的路。

sentences.en: They also fronted the media, begging for those who knew anything about Evelyn's whereabouts to come forward.
sentences.zh: 他们还出面面对媒体，恳求知晓伊芙琳下落的人站出来。

sentences.en: They soon received two phone calls from a man who said he had information about Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 不久，他们接到了一个男子的两个电话，对方声称自己掌握了关于伊芙琳的信息。

sentences.en: He would give it to them in exchange for $500 cash.
sentences.zh: 他愿意用这些信息交换500美元现金。

sentences.en: It was to be placed inside a paper bag, then left in the bathroom of the bathroom of a La Crosse drugstore.
sentences.zh: 钱必须放进纸袋里，然后留在拉克罗斯一家药店的洗手间里。

sentences.en: The man said he would leave a letter in the bathroom that revealed Evelyn's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 这名男子说他会在洗手间里留下一封信，透露伊芙琳的下落。

sentences.en: The family was warned not to go to the police.
sentences.zh: 家属被警告不得报警。

sentences.en: With the money in her possession, Ethel Hartley headed into the store.
sentences.zh: 埃塞尔·哈特利带着钱走进了这家商店。

sentences.en: She went up a flight of stairs to the balcony where the bathrooms were located.
sentences.zh: 她顺着楼梯来到设有洗手间的阳台。

sentences.en: Ethel looked for the letter the man said would be there, but there was nothing.
sentences.zh: 埃塞尔寻找那名男子所说应该在那里的信件，但什么也没有。

sentences.en: She then left.
sentences.zh: 随后她离开了。

sentences.en: The entire time, a 13-year-old boy was following Ethel.
sentences.zh: 整个过程，一个13岁的男孩一直在尾随埃塞尔。

sentences.en: When she walked out of the drugstore, the boy returned to the shop's main floor.
sentences.zh: 当她走出药店时，那个男孩回到了店铺的主楼层。

sentences.en: There, he met up with a 20-year-old man named
sentences.zh: 在那里，他和一个名叫杰克·达弗林的20岁男子碰面了

sentences.en: Jack Dufferin.
sentences.zh: 杰克·达弗林。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to Dufferin and the boy, plainclothes police officers were stationed throughout the store.
sentences.zh: 达弗林和那个男孩并不知道，便衣警察当时已经部署在商店的各个角落。

sentences.en: Despite being warned not to, the Hartleys had told investigators about the phone call from the start.
sentences.zh: 尽管被警告不要这样做，但哈特利一家从一开始就把这个电话告诉了调查人员。

sentences.en: Both Dufferin and the boy were arrested, with Dufferin insisting he had nothing to do with it.
sentences.zh: 达弗林和那个男孩双双被捕，达弗林坚称自己与此无关。

sentences.en: There was nothing to tie him to Evelyn's abduction, but he was convicted of extortion and sentenced to one to three years.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据将他与伊芙琳的绑架案联系起来，但他因敲诈勒索罪被定罪，并被判处一到三年监禁。

sentences.en: After this, the Hartleys avoided publicity.
sentences.zh: 此后，哈特利一家开始回避公众视线。

sentences.en: They decided to leave the case to the police and deal with their grief and anguish in private.
sentences.zh: 他们决定把案件交给警方，并在私下里处理他们的悲痛与痛苦。

sentences.en: But they were never left alone.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未真正获得安宁。

sentences.en: In November 1953, Richard Hartley received a letter.
sentences.zh: 1953年11月，理查德·哈特利收到了一封信。

sentences.en: Postmarks revealed it had been sent from North Dakota, specifically the Devil's Lake area.
sentences.zh: 邮戳显示信是自北达科他州寄出的，具体是魔鬼湖地区。

sentences.en: It read,
sentences.zh: 信上写着：

sentences.en: Just a note to let you know that Miss Hartley is in my power.
sentences.zh: “写信只是为了让你知道哈特利小姐在我手上。”

sentences.en: Don't try to trace this letter because I didn't leave any evidence.
sentences.zh: “别试图追踪这封信，因为我没有留下任何证据。”

sentences.en: I'll let you know the ransom later.
sentences.zh: “我稍后会告诉你赎金的事。”

sentences.en: You stupid people almost had me, but I managed to escape.
sentences.zh: “你们这群蠢货差点就抓到我了，但我还是设法逃掉了。”

sentences.en: Scribbled on the letter was a drawing of a skull and crossbones.
sentences.zh: 信上胡乱涂鸦着一个骷髅头和交叉骨的图案。

sentences.en: Then, in 1958, Evelyn's mother received a parcel that contained a girl's gym shirt.
sentences.zh: 接着，在1958年，伊芙琳的母亲收到一个包裹，里面有一件女孩的运动衫。

sentences.en: There was no explanation and apparently no link to Evelyn, though a note from the sender stated that the shirt would be of some interest to Ethel.
sentences.zh: 没有任何解释，表面上也和伊芙琳没有任何联系，不过寄件人的一张便条称这件运动衫会对埃塞尔有些吸引力。

sentences.en: That same year, a man with a wild stare showed up at the Hartleys' home and ranted about knowing where Evelyn was.
sentences.zh: 同年，一个眼神狂热的男子出现在哈特利家门口，语无伦次地嚷嚷着自己知道伊芙琳在哪里。

sentences.en: Police handled the matter, but the man returned four days later.
sentences.zh: 警方处理了此事，但该男子四天后又回来了。

sentences.en: After visiting the Hartleys, he headed to the home of the Rasmussons.
sentences.zh: 在拜访了哈特利家后，他前往了拉斯穆森的住所。

sentences.en: They had since moved to a new house, unable to bear living in the place where Evelyn was taken.
sentences.zh: 他们当时已经搬到了一处新房子里，实在无法忍受住在伊芙琳被带走的地方。

sentences.en: Both families were terrified of the man, who appeared to be a religious fanatic prone to nonsensical rants.
sentences.zh: 两家人都对这个男人感到恐惧，他看起来像是一个容易胡言乱语的宗教狂热分子。

sentences.en: He continued to be fixated by the case, sending long confusing letters to investigators and making anonymous calls asking for leads.
sentences.zh: 他依然对这起案件执迷不悟，不断向调查人员寄送长篇大论、令人费解的信件，并打匿名电话索要线索。

sentences.en: As far as detectives could tell, his only connection to
sentences.zh: 就侦探们所能了解到的情况而言，他与

sentences.en: Evelyn Hartley was an unhealthy obsession with her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·哈特利的唯一联系就是对她失踪一事的病态痴迷。

sentences.en: He wasn't the only one.
sentences.zh: 他并不是唯一一个这样的人。

sentences.en: The police received countless letters, phone calls and tip-offs from people certain they knew where
sentences.zh: 警方收到了无数信件、电话和线索，来自那些坚信自己知道伊芙琳在哪里

sentences.en: Evelyn was or who had taken her.
sentences.zh: 或是谁绑架了她的人。

sentences.en: Some were clairvoyants, others spoke of having prophetic dreams that solved the case.
sentences.zh: 有些人是灵媒，另一些则声称自己做了能破案的预言梦。

sentences.en: Multiple individuals falsely confessed to the crime, including at least two men in mental health facilities.
sentences.zh: 多名男子虚假供认了这起罪行，其中包括至少两名精神卫生机构的男子。

sentences.en: On several occasions, teenage girls and young women claimed to be
sentences.zh: 在好几个场合，十几岁的女孩和年轻女性自称是

sentences.en: Evelyn Hartley.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·哈特利。

sentences.en: Although the Hartleys insisted they were happy with the police's work and believed they would solve the case, other locals were disgruntled.
sentences.zh: 尽管哈特利夫妇坚称他们对警方的办案工作感到满意，并相信他们会破案，但其他当地人却很不满。

sentences.en: Some remarked, if you want to get away with murder, move to La Crosse.
sentences.zh: 有人评论说，如果你想谋杀逍遥法外，就搬到拉克罗斯去。

sentences.en: They were also angry that the FBI hadn't become involved in the investigation, as they typically did with kidnappings.
sentences.zh: 他们也很生气，因为联邦调查局没有像通常处理绑架案那样介入调查。

sentences.en: The La Crosse law enforcement had apparently asked for the FBI's assistance from the outset, but described the case as a sex crime, not an abduction.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯执法部门显然从一开始就请求联邦调查局协助，但将此案描述为性犯罪，而非绑架。

sentences.en: Consequently, the FBI refused to get involved.
sentences.zh: 因此，联邦调查局拒绝介入。

sentences.en: 84-year-old Howard George knew he didn't have much time left and wanted to spend his money in a meaningful way before he passed.
sentences.zh: 84岁的霍华德·乔治知道自己时日无多，想在离世前以有意义的方式花掉他的钱。

sentences.en: Solving La Crosse's most enduring and painful mystery seemed like the obvious answer.
sentences.zh: 解决拉克罗斯最持久、最痛苦的谜团似乎是显而易见的答案。

sentences.en: So, in 1958, Howard hired some private detectives to look into Evelyn Hartley's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 因此，在1958年，霍华德雇了一些私人侦探来调查伊芙琳·哈特利的失踪案。

sentences.en: They hit a roadblock when La Crosse police wouldn't share their files with them.
sentences.zh: 当拉克罗斯警方拒绝与他们分享档案时，他们遇到了障碍。

sentences.en: As a result, they wasted time, resources and money looking into suspects who had already been cleared.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们浪费了时间、资源和金钱去调查那些已经被洗脱嫌疑的人。

sentences.en: When Howard George's actions became publicly known, his small and modest home was ransacked.
sentences.zh: 当霍华德·乔治的行动广为人知时，他那栋简朴的小房子被洗劫一空。

sentences.en: Though nothing was stolen.
sentences.zh: 尽管什么也没丢。

sentences.en: After he passed away and their funds dried up, the private investigators had to reluctantly cease their involvement.
sentences.zh: 在他去世并且资金耗尽后，私人侦探们不得不不情愿地停止参与。

sentences.en: In a final report, they noted the innumerable unanswered questions that remained and concluded.
sentences.zh: 在最后一份报告中，他们指出了无数挥之不去的未解之谜，并总结道。

sentences.en: The Evelyn Hartley disappearance will always be a thorn in the city of La Crosse's side until solved.
sentences.zh: 在水落石出之前，伊芙琳·哈特利失踪案将永远是拉克罗斯市的一根刺。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《罪案档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商以支持我们。

sentences.en: It was around 5pm on Saturday November 16, 1957, when Deputy Sheriff Frank Warden approached the entrance of a hardware store in the Wisconsin town of Plainfield.
sentences.zh: 那是1957年11月16日星期六下午5点左右，副警长弗兰克·沃登走近威斯康星州普兰菲尔德镇一家五金店的入口。

sentences.en: He tried the door, only to discover it was locked.
sentences.zh: 他试着推门，却发现门锁着。

sentences.en: Frank was puzzled.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克感到很困惑。

sentences.en: The hardware store was owned by his mother, 58-year-old Bernice, and Frank had arrived to help her out before closing time in one hour.
sentences.zh: 这家五金店是他58岁的母亲伯尼斯开的，弗兰克来这里是为了在一小时后的关门时间前帮她的忙。

sentences.en: As it turned out, no one had been inside the hardware store since earlier that morning.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，自那天早些时候以来，五金店里一直没有人。

sentences.en: Customers had approached, but finding the shop locked up, they'd assumed it was closed.
sentences.zh: 曾有顾客走近，但发现店铺上锁后，便以为已经关门了。

sentences.en: At 9.30am, the store's truck was witnessed pulling out of the garage at the rear of the property and driving away.
sentences.zh: 上午9点30分，有人看到该店的卡车从房产后方的车库开出并驶离。

sentences.en: Frank broke into the store.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克破门进入店里。

sentences.en: He didn't find his mother, but the cash register was open and there was a small pool of blood behind the counter.
sentences.zh: 他没有找到母亲，但收银机开着，柜台后面有一小滩血迹。

sentences.en: There was also a receipt written in his mother's handwriting for a gallon of antifreeze.
sentences.zh: 还有一张他母亲亲笔写的购买一加仑防冻液的收据。

sentences.en: Frank recalled that the previous evening, a local handyman had been asking about antifreeze and had promised to return to pick up a gallon the next day.
sentences.zh: 弗兰克回想起前一天晚上，有个当地的杂工一直在打听防冻液的事，并承诺第二天回来取一加仑。

sentences.en: A few hours later, police found the man at a nearby grocery store and placed him under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，警察在附近的一家杂货店找到了这名男子并将其逮捕。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, other officers drove out to the man's property.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，其他警官开车前往该男子的房产。

sentences.en: He lived alone in a large weatherboard farmhouse that had belonged to his parents.
sentences.zh: 他独自住在一个曾经属于他父母的大型木板农舍里。

sentences.en: The residence sat within a 155 acre farm, much of which was cloaked in snow and dotted with bare trees.
sentences.zh: 这栋住宅坐落在一个155英亩的农场内，大部分土地被白雪覆盖，点缀着光秃秃的树木。

sentences.en: Overall, it had a grim and gloomy atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这里有一种阴森沉闷的氛围。

sentences.en: A sheriff's deputy made his way towards a shed.
sentences.zh: 一名警长副手朝着一个棚屋走去。

sentences.en: He walked inside and was immediately confronted by the naked body of Bernice Warden hanging upside down from a crossbar.
sentences.zh: 他走进去，立刻看到伯尼斯·沃登赤裸的尸体倒挂在一根横梁上。

sentences.en: Her wrists were bound with rope and she had been beheaded.
sentences.zh: 她的手腕被绳子绑着，而且已经惨遭斩首。

sentences.en: She had also been gutted like a deer, with her internal organs removed.
sentences.zh: 她还像鹿一样被开膛破肚，内脏被摘除。

sentences.en: Inside the nearby farmhouse, police found Bernice's organs wrapped inside a dress.
sentences.zh: 在附近的农舍内，警察发现伯尼斯的内脏被包在一条连衣裙里。

sentences.en: Her head was also there.
sentences.zh: 她的头也在那里。

sentences.en: The handyman would confess to entering the hardware store and marching straight to the back where guns were displayed for sale.
sentences.zh: 该杂工供认自己进入五金店，径直走到后面展示枪支出售的地方。

sentences.en: He'd taken down a .22 caliber rifle, which Bernice Warden assumed he wanted to purchase.
sentences.zh: 他取下一支.22口径步枪，伯尼斯·沃登以为他想买这把枪。

sentences.en: As she stood waiting to ring it up for him, the handyman loaded it with one bullet he'd brought from home, then fired a single shot into
sentences.zh: 正当她站在那等着为他结账时，杂工用从家里带的一颗子弹装填了枪，然后朝着

sentences.en: Bernice's head.
sentences.zh: 伯尼斯的头部开了一枪。

sentences.en: He'd then taken her body to his house, where he mutilated it.
sentences.zh: 随后他把她的尸体带回自己家，并在那里进行了肢解。

sentences.en: He had been busy.
sentences.zh: 他一直很忙碌。

sentences.en: A search of the man's farmhouse uncovered another ten female skulls, some of which had been put on top of bedposts.
sentences.zh: 对该男子农舍的搜查发现了另外十个女性头骨，其中一些被放在床柱顶上。

sentences.en: He'd upholstered chairs with human skin, made masks from women's faces, and a belt out of nipples.
sentences.zh: 他用人皮包裹椅子，用女性的面孔制作面具，还用乳头制作了一条皮带。

sentences.en: Female genitals that had been removed were found stashed in a shoebox.
sentences.zh: 被切除的女性生殖器被藏在一个鞋盒里。

sentences.en: The handyman was 51-year-old
sentences.zh: 这名杂工当时51岁

sentences.en: Edward Gein, better known as Ed.
sentences.zh: 名叫爱德华·盖恩，人称埃德。

sentences.en: He would come to be known as one of the most notorious killers in
sentences.zh: 他后来成为

sentences.en: American history, with his crimes providing the inspiration for novels and films such as Psycho and Silence of the Lambs.
sentences.zh: 美国历史上最臭名昭著的杀手之一，他的罪行为《惊魂记》和《沉默的羔羊》等小说和电影提供了灵感。

sentences.en: Gein had a fixation with his mother, who had been a devout Christian.
sentences.zh: 盖恩对他的母亲有一种执念，她曾是一位虔诚的基督徒。

sentences.en: She'd preached to her sons about the immorality of the world.
sentences.zh: 她向儿子们宣讲这个世界的堕落。

sentences.en: Women were especially evil, she said, with the exception of herself.
sentences.zh: 她说女性尤其邪恶，除了她自己以外。

sentences.en: They were promiscuous and used to do the devil's bidding.
sentences.zh: 她们生性风流，习惯于听从魔鬼的差遣。

sentences.en: Gein's father died and then his brother, leaving just Gein and his mother.
sentences.zh: 盖恩的父亲去世了，接着是他的兄弟，只剩下盖恩和母亲。

sentences.en: After she suffered a debilitating stroke,
sentences.zh: 在她遭受了严重的中风之后，

sentences.en: Gein devoted himself to her recovery.
sentences.zh: 盖恩全身心投入到照顾她康复中。

sentences.en: She died in 1945 at the age of 67, when Gein was 39.
sentences.zh: 她于1945年去世，享年67岁，当时盖恩39岁。

sentences.en: Devastated and all alone, Gein remained living in the family home, but boarded up the portions of the house his mother had used.
sentences.zh: 悲痛欲绝又孤身一人的盖恩继续住在家族住宅里，但用木板封住了母亲用过的那些房间。

sentences.en: His living quarters were reduced to the kitchen and a small room next door.
sentences.zh: 他的起居空间缩减到了厨房和旁边的一个小房间。

sentences.en: Between 1947 and 1952, Gein visited three nearby cemeteries at night to dig up the graves of recently buried women.
sentences.zh: 在1947年至1952年间，盖恩在夜间造访了三个附近的墓地，去挖掘新近下葬的女尸。

sentences.en: Sometimes he took the bodies home with him and mutilated them.
sentences.zh: 有时他把尸体带回家并进行肢解。

sentences.en: He particularly focused on the corpses of middle-aged women who resembled his mother, though body parts belonging to adolescent girls were also found in his house.
sentences.zh: 他特别专注于那些长得像他母亲的中年妇女尸体，不过他的家里也找到了属于青春期女孩的身体部位。

sentences.en: His dream was to create a suit of human skin that looked like his mother so he could wear it and become her.
sentences.zh: 他的梦想是制作一件看起来像他母亲的人皮衣服，这样他就可以穿上它并成为她。

sentences.en: As well as admitting to killing Bernice Warden,
sentences.zh: 除了承认杀害伯尼斯·沃登之外，

sentences.en: Gein said he'd murdered a tavern owner named Mary Hogan.
sentences.zh: 盖恩还供认他谋杀了一位名叫玛丽·霍根的酒馆老板。

sentences.en: She had been missing since 1954, and her head was recovered from his house.
sentences.zh: 她自1954年以来一直失踪，她的头部在他的家中被找回。

sentences.en: The gruesome crimes of Ed Gein led to him being dubbed the Butcher of Plainfield.
sentences.zh: 埃德·盖恩骇人听闻的罪行使他被称为“普兰菲尔德屠夫”。

sentences.en: He was ultimately diagnosed with schizophrenia and deemed not guilty by reason of insanity.
sentences.zh: 他最终被诊断患有精神分裂症，并被判定因精神失常而无罪。

sentences.en: Gein spent the remainder of his life in a hospital for the criminally insane.
sentences.zh: 盖恩在一家刑事精神病院度过了余生。

sentences.en: It was said that on the night Evelyn Hartley disappeared in 1953, Ed Gein had been visiting relatives who lived in or near La Crosse.
sentences.zh: 据说在1953年伊芙琳·哈特利失踪的那天晚上，埃德·盖恩一直在探访住在拉克罗斯或其附近的亲戚。

sentences.en: La Crosse was where Gein was born before his family relocated more than 100 miles east to Plainfield.
sentences.zh: 拉克罗斯是盖恩出生的地方，后来他的家族向东搬迁了100多英里来到普兰菲尔德。

sentences.en: Hartley case investigators interviewed Gein for more than an hour in relation to the crime.
sentences.zh: 哈特利案调查人员就此犯罪对盖恩进行了长达一个多小时的讯问。

sentences.en: He told them that he hadn't been to La Crosse since his family left when he was eight.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，自从他八岁家族离开以来，他就再没去过拉克罗斯。

sentences.en: Evelyn Hartley's dental records were compared to the remains found in Gein's home.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳·哈特利的牙科记录与在盖恩家中发现的遗骸进行了比对。

sentences.en: None were a match.
sentences.zh: 没有一处吻合。

sentences.en: The manner in which Evelyn was attacked was inconsistent with Ed Gein's modus operandi.
sentences.zh: 伊芙琳遭受袭击的方式与埃德·盖恩的作案手法不符。

sentences.en: He was only confirmed to have killed two middle-aged women whom he knew and who reminded him of his mother.
sentences.zh: 经确认他只杀害了两名他认识且让他想起母亲的中年女性。

sentences.en: In both instances, he murdered them with a firearm.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，他都是用火器谋杀了她们。

sentences.en: The rest of the female body parts found in his farmhouse were the result of his grave robbing.
sentences.zh: 在他农舍里发现的其余女性身体部位都是他盗墓的结果。

sentences.en: In contrast, Evelyn was unknown to Gein, was in the wrong age group, and the evidence from the crime scene was nothing like Gein's confirmed murders.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，伊芙琳不认识盖恩，年龄段不对，而且犯罪现场的证据与盖恩已确定的谋杀案完全不同。

sentences.en: Investigators ruled Ed Gein out as a possible perpetrator in the Hartley case.
sentences.zh: 调查人员排除埃德·盖恩为哈特利案潜在凶手的可能。

sentences.en: As the 50th anniversary of Evelyn Hartley's disappearance approached in 2003, local newspaper the La Crosse Tribune published a number of articles reflecting on the case.
sentences.zh: 随着2003年伊芙琳·哈特利失踪50周年纪念日的临近，当地报纸《拉克罗斯论坛报》发表了多篇回顾该案的文章。

sentences.en: One focused on the efforts of a local history buff who was determined to solve it.
sentences.zh: 其中一篇聚焦于一位决意破案的当地历史爱好者的努力。

sentences.en: A realtor in La Crosse by day, Andrew Thompson, had a fascination with unsolved mysteries that occupied his spare time.
sentences.zh: 安德鲁·汤普森白天是拉克罗斯的一名房地产经纪人，他对未解之谜的迷恋占据了他的业余时间。

sentences.en: When his business partner
sentences.zh: 当他的商业伙伴

sentences.en: Peggy Lovejoy told him about their town's very own ongoing mystery, Andrew was intrigued.
sentences.zh: 佩吉·洛夫乔伊向他讲述他们镇上正在进行的神秘悬案时，安德鲁很感兴趣。

sentences.en: He and
sentences.zh: 他和

sentences.en: Peggy began looking into the Hartley case with some help from local police.
sentences.zh: 佩吉在当地警方的协助下开始调查哈特利案。

sentences.en: They also hired a former
sentences.zh: 他们还雇佣了一位前

sentences.en: La Crosse Tribune journalist named Susan Hassel as they wished to publish a book about Evelyn and needed a writer.
sentences.zh: 《拉克罗斯论坛报》记者名叫苏珊·哈塞尔，因为他们希望出版一本关于伊芙琳的书，需要一名作家。

sentences.en: Soon, an article detailing their efforts ran in the paper.
sentences.zh: 不久，一篇详细报道他们努力的文章在报纸上刊登。

sentences.en: When a local man named Mel Williams read the article, his mind began to tick.
sentences.zh: 当一个名叫梅尔·威廉姆斯的当地人读到这篇文章时，他的脑海开始运转。

sentences.en: One night in 1969, Mel visited a bar owned by his brother in the Wisconsin town of La Farche about 40 miles southeast of La Crosse.
sentences.zh: 1969年的一天晚上，梅尔去了一家由他兄弟经营的酒吧，该酒吧位于拉克罗斯东南约40英里的威斯康星州拉法奇镇。

sentences.en: A group of patrons, including Mel, stayed until after closing, talking and drinking into the early hours.
sentences.zh: 包括梅尔在内的一群顾客一直待到打烊之后，边聊边喝，直到清晨。

sentences.en: One of them was Clyde Tywee Peterson, a small man with a drinking problem and a reputation for stealing.
sentences.zh: 其中一人是克莱德·特威·彼得森，个子矮小，有酗酒问题，且有偷窃前科。

sentences.en: Despite this, Mel found Peterson likeable and amusing.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，梅尔发现彼得森讨人喜欢又滑稽。

sentences.en: As the drinks flowed, Peterson began telling a story about how he used to smuggle whiskey into a ward that housed alcoholics at a local psychiatric hospital.
sentences.zh: 随着酒越喝越多，彼得森开始讲一个故事，讲述他过去如何将威士忌走私到当地一家精神病院收治酗酒者的病房。

sentences.en: Another man who was present named Whitey Barclay asked,
sentences.zh: 在场的另一个人名叫韦蒂·巴克利，他问：

sentences.en: That's about the time you hauled that Hartley girl down there, that right?
sentences.zh: 那就是你把那个哈特利女孩拖到那儿的时候吧，对吗？

sentences.en: Peterson avoided the question, but Whitey persisted.
sentences.zh: 彼得森避而不答，但韦蒂穷追不舍。

sentences.en: You hauled her from La Crosse down to another address and back to La Crosse, huh?
sentences.zh: 你把她从拉克罗斯拖到另一个地址，然后又带回拉克罗斯，对吧？

sentences.en: Peterson initially said no.
sentences.zh: 彼得森起初说没有。

sentences.en: Whitey was insistent.
sentences.zh: 韦蒂坚持不放。

sentences.en: You did haul her up there though, he repeated.
sentences.zh: 不过你确实把她拖到那儿去了，他重复道。

sentences.en: Peterson finally replied.
sentences.zh: 彼得森终于回答了。

sentences.en: No witness, no proof.
sentences.zh: 没有证人，就没有证据。

sentences.en: They haven't found her, have they?
sentences.zh: 他们还没找到她，不是吗？

sentences.en: Others listening in on the conversation asked who the Hartley girl was.
sentences.zh: 其他旁听对话的人问那个哈特利女孩是谁。

sentences.en: Whitey explained Evelyn Hartley's abduction and implicated two other men in the crime as well.
sentences.zh: 韦蒂解释了伊芙琳·哈特利的绑架案，并暗示另外两名男子也参与了这起罪行。

sentences.en: One was named Jack Golfair.
sentences.zh: 其中一人名叫杰克·戈尔费尔。

sentences.en: Allegedly, Jack had met Evelyn when they attended the same parties.
sentences.zh: 据称，杰克在参加同一场派对时认识了伊芙琳。

sentences.en: He had known she was babysitting at the Rasmussons that night.
sentences.zh: 他知道她那天晚上在拉斯穆森家做保姆。

sentences.en: He, Clyde Peterson, and the other unnamed man abducted Evelyn, then later killed her at a house elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 他和克莱德·彼得森以及另一个未具名的男子绑架了伊芙琳，后来在别处的房子里杀害了她。

sentences.en: Whitey claimed he had been the one to dig
sentences.zh: 韦蒂声称自己就是那个在拉法奇一个假定地点

sentences.en: Evelyn's grave in a supposed location in La Farge.
sentences.zh: 挖伊芙琳坟墓的人。

sentences.en: The conversation lasted about seven minutes.
sentences.zh: 这段对话持续了大约七分钟。

sentences.en: Then, Whitey noticed a device Mel Williams had brought with him to the bar that night.
sentences.zh: 然后，韦蒂注意到了梅尔·威廉姆斯那天晚上带到酒吧的一个设备。

sentences.en: Mel was visiting from Nashville, Tennessee, where he'd relocated to in an attempt to become a country music star.
sentences.zh: 梅尔是从田纳西州纳什维尔来探访的，他以前为了成为乡村音乐明星而搬到了那里。

sentences.en: Bands were performing at the bar earlier that evening, so Mel had set up a reel-to-reel recorder to tape their sets.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上早些时候，乐队在酒吧表演，所以梅尔架设了一台盘式录音机来录制他们的演出。

sentences.en: He had left it on long after the music stopped, capturing the conversation between Clyde Tywee Peterson and Whitey Barclay about Evelyn Hartley's murder.
sentences.zh: 音乐停止后很久他仍让它开着，记录下了克莱德·特威·彼得森和韦蒂·巴克利关于伊芙琳·哈特利谋杀案的对话。

sentences.en: Upon noticing the recording device, Whitey told Mel to turn it off, and the conversation was dropped.
sentences.zh: 注意到录音设备后，韦蒂让梅尔把它关掉，对话也就此打住。

sentences.en: Mel knew Jack at Golfair and believed he was capable of killing someone.
sentences.zh: 梅尔认识杰克·戈尔费尔，并相信他有能力杀人。

sentences.en: He would later describe him to author
sentences.zh: 他后来向作家

sentences.en: Susan Hessel as violent and vicious, but thought little of the conversation at the time due to how drunk the men were.
sentences.zh: 苏珊·黑塞尔描述他暴力而残酷，但当时由于男人们都喝醉了，他并没有把这段对话当回事。

sentences.en: Maybe they were just trying to big note themselves.
sentences.zh: 也许他们只是在吹牛充老大。

sentences.en: He would later toss the tape recorded at the bar that night into a box, along with dozens of others he'd made over the years.
sentences.zh: 他后来把那天晚上在酒吧录的磁带扔进了一个盒子里，里面还有他多年来录制的几十个其他磁带。

sentences.en: When the 50th anniversary of Evelyn Hartley's disappearance was making headlines,
sentences.zh: 当伊芙琳·哈特利失踪50周年纪念日成为头条新闻时，

sentences.en: Mel retrieved the tape he'd made at the bar 34 years prior which had captured the confession.
sentences.zh: 梅尔找回了他在34年前在酒吧录下记录了供认的那盘磁带。

sentences.en: Now 76 years old, Mel passed the recording to those collaborating on the book about Evelyn's case.
sentences.zh: 当时76岁的梅尔将录音交给了那些合作撰写关于伊芙琳案书籍的人。

sentences.en: They in turn handed it to the authorities.
sentences.zh: 他们转手将其交给了当局。

sentences.en: Investigators described the tape as,
sentences.zh: 调查人员将这盘磁带描述为：

sentences.en: The best lead we've ever had.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的最好线索。

sentences.en: However, Clyde Tywee Peterson, Jack Golfair and the third man implicated in the crime were all deceased.
sentences.zh: 然而，克莱德·特威·彼得森、杰克·戈尔费尔以及案件中涉及的第三名男子均已过世。

sentences.en: Golfair had taken his own life on Christmas Day, 1967.
sentences.zh: 戈尔费尔于1967年圣诞节自杀身亡。

sentences.en: Amateur sleuth Andrew Thompson visited Whitey Barclay's wife.
sentences.zh: 业余侦探安德鲁·汤普森拜访了韦蒂·巴克利的妻子。

sentences.en: She believed Evelyn Hartley had been in Lafarge the night before she vanished.
sentences.zh: 她相信伊芙琳·哈特利在失踪前一晚曾在拉法奇。

sentences.en: She took Andrew to meet her husband.
sentences.zh: 她带安德鲁去见她的丈夫。

sentences.en: By this time, Whitey had dementia and was living in a nursing home.
sentences.zh: 此时，韦蒂患有痴呆症，住在疗养院里。

sentences.en: When Evelyn's name was mentioned, the elderly man froze, but did not speak.
sentences.zh: 当提到伊芙琳的名字时，这位老人的身体僵住了，但没有说话。

sentences.en: Lafarge was one of the locations where the denim jacket and shoes that were believed to belong to Evelyn's abductors had been put on display.
sentences.zh: 拉法奇是据信属于伊芙琳绑架者的牛仔夹克和鞋子曾被展出过的地点之一。

sentences.en: Rumours had spread amongst locals that the jacket was familiar.
sentences.zh: 当地人中流传着传言说这件夹克很眼熟。

sentences.en: They'd seen an acquaintance of Peterson and Golfair's wearing it before.
sentences.zh: 他们以前曾看到过彼得森和戈尔费尔的一个熟人穿过它。

sentences.en: Some have speculated that it was Peterson who wore the jacket.
sentences.zh: 有人推测穿夹克的是彼得森。

sentences.en: He was a small man and it was a small size.
sentences.zh: 他个子矮小，而这是一件小号衣服。

sentences.en: The Goodrich sneakers recovered were believed to have been worn by two men at different times, one who was very tall and the other shorter.
sentences.zh: 据信，找回的古德里奇运动鞋曾被两名男子在不同时期穿过，其中一人个子很高，另一人较矮。

sentences.en: Peterson was known to wear secondhand clothing.
sentences.zh: 彼得森以穿二手衣物而闻名。

sentences.en: Investigators had made enquiries about Clyde Peterson and Jack Golfair back in 1968.
sentences.zh: 早在1968年，调查人员就曾对克莱德·彼得森和杰克·戈尔费尔展开过调查。

sentences.en: It was unclear how the men came to be on their radar, but they later said they'd never been able to substantiate claims they had killed Evelyn.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚这两人是如何进入他们视线的，但调查人员后来表示，他们从未能证实两人杀害埃弗林的说法。

sentences.en: When investigators looked into the men again in 2004, they were unable to come up with anything concrete tying them to the case.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员在2004年再次调查这两人时，他们没能找到任何实质性证据将这两人与此案联系起来。

sentences.en: In her book, Where's Evelyn?, author Susan Hessel mentions the possibility that the men's bodies could one day be exhumed for DNA testing.
sentences.zh: 作家苏珊·黑塞尔在她的书《埃弗林在哪里？》中提到了一种可能性，即有朝一日可以开棺验尸以进行DNA检测。

sentences.en: Attempts to obtain DNA evidence from blood found at the crime scene have so far proved unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 从犯罪现场发现的血液中提取DNA证据的尝试迄今为止均未成功。

sentences.en: Susan Hessel published Where's Evelyn in 2005 after extensive research alongside Andrew
sentences.zh: 苏珊·黑塞尔在与安德鲁·

sentences.en: Thompson and Peggy Lovejoy.
sentences.zh: 汤普森和佩吉·拉夫乔伊进行了大量研究后，于2005年出版了《埃弗林在哪里？》。

sentences.en: As well as combing through archives and police files, Susan interviewed residents of La Crosse who spoke about the loss of innocence experienced by the community in the
sentences.zh: 除了翻阅档案和警察档案外，苏珊还采访了拉克罗斯的居民，他们谈到了在

sentences.en: wake of Evelyn's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 埃弗林失踪之后，社区所经历的纯真丧失。

sentences.en: Curfews were introduced, doors were kept locked, girls no longer walked alone and families struggled to find babysitters.
sentences.zh: 宵禁出台了，大门紧闭，女孩们不再独自步行，家庭也很难找到保姆。

sentences.en: The Rasmussen family were haunted by the tragedy that had taken place in their home, with Viggo Rasmussen telling a journalist in 1978,
sentences.zh: 拉斯穆森一家一直被发生在家中的悲剧所困扰，维戈·拉斯穆森在1978年对一名记者说：

sentences.en: It's a nightmare whenever we think of it.
sentences.zh: 每当想到这件事，这就是一场噩梦。

sentences.en: I don't mean it preys on our minds constantly, but we don't forget it, no matter how long ago it was.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说它一直萦绕在我们的心头，但无论过去多久，我们都不会忘记它。

sentences.en: Evelyn's remaining family members were too heartbroken to participate in Susan Hessel's book, but some of her friends gave interviews,
sentences.zh: 埃弗林的其他家人因为过于伤心而没有参与苏珊·黑塞尔的书，但她的一些朋友接受了采访，

sentences.en: including her best friend, a girl named Mary Sequist-Wall.
sentences.zh: 其中包括她最好的朋友，一个名叫玛丽·西奎斯特-沃尔的女孩。

sentences.en: Mary shared some of her favourite memories with Susan.
sentences.zh: 玛丽与苏珊分享了她的一些美好回忆。

sentences.en: She recalled Evelyn as someone who loved music and would walk down the street playing a ukulele and singing.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，埃弗林是一个热爱音乐的人，会拿着尤克里里一边走在街上一边弹唱。

sentences.en: Mary joined the Hartleys on their many trips to the great outdoors, and they would all go hiking through the woods together.
sentences.zh: 玛丽加入了哈特利一家的许多户外远足活动，大家会一起去树林里徒步旅行。

sentences.en: The girls would have sleepovers and laugh at silly jokes while Evelyn's parents made them popcorn.
sentences.zh: 女孩们会举行睡衣派对，在埃弗林父母为她们做爆米花时，为一些无聊的笑话开怀大笑。

sentences.en: During one slumber party, Evelyn and her friends snuck out of the house at dawn, still wearing their pyjamas, and rode their bicycles over to the local swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 在一次睡衣派对期间，埃弗林和她的朋友们在黎明时分偷偷溜出家门，身上还穿着睡衣，骑着自行车去了当地的游泳池。

sentences.en: It was closed, but the girls climbed the fence and jumped into the pool.
sentences.zh: 当时游泳池关门了，但女孩们还是爬上栅栏跳进了泳池。

sentences.en: On the day that Evelyn went missing, Mary had passed her driving test and obtained her licence.
sentences.zh: 在埃弗林失踪的那天，玛丽刚刚通过了驾驶考试并拿到了驾照。

sentences.en: That evening, she felt disappointed that Evelyn was babysitting because she wanted to share the exciting news.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她感到很失望，因为埃弗林当时正在当保姆，而她很想分享这个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: At around 7pm, she decided to call her and went to the telephone.
sentences.zh: 晚上7点左右，她决定打电话给她，于是走到了电话机旁。

sentences.en: But because she didn't know how to spell the surname Rasmussen, she couldn't look up the family's phone number in a phone book.
sentences.zh: 但由于她不知道姓氏拉斯穆森怎么拼写，她在电话簿里查不到这家人电话号码。

sentences.en: Mary told author Susan Hessel, I put the phone back.
sentences.zh: 玛丽告诉作家苏珊·黑塞尔：我把电话放回去了。

sentences.en: I thought I'd talk with Evelyn tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我想我明天再和埃弗林聊天。

sentences.en: That was about the time it happened.
sentences.zh: 差不多就在那个时候，事情发生了。

sentences.en: News soon broke that Evelyn had been taken.
sentences.zh: 不久后传出消息称埃弗林被绑架了。

sentences.en: Mary explained to Susan Hessel,
sentences.zh: 玛丽向苏珊·黑塞尔解释说：

sentences.en: It changed how I live.
sentences.zh: 这改变了我的生活方式。

sentences.en: I just have a hard time with it.
sentences.zh: 我只是觉得这很难接受。

sentences.en: I feel so awful that it had to be her, and she is such a wonderful person.
sentences.zh: 一想到偏偏是她，而她又是一个如此优秀的人，我就感到非常难过。

sentences.en: As of mid 2022, Evelyn Hartley's case remains unsolved.
sentences.zh: 截至2022年中期，埃弗林·哈特利案仍然悬而未决。

sentences.en: Her remains have not been found.
sentences.zh: 她的遗骸尚未找到。

sentences.en: Richard and Ethel Hartley passed away without learning what happened to their daughter.
sentences.zh: 理查德和埃塞尔·哈特利在至死也没能得知女儿遭遇了什么。

sentences.en: What are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你在干什么？

sentences.en: I'm so proud of what I can do with her.
sentences.zh: 我为自己能用她做到这些感到无比自豪。

sentences.en: You are so proud of this, for the big part of the UK.
sentences.zh: 你为这个在英国占很大比重的事情感到非常骄傲。

sentences.en: I am so proud of you.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: You are so proud of my family.
sentences.zh: 你为我的家人感到骄傲。
